fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide stories.rss feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. 'not_found', 'blocked_or_transient').

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle, article-mode). Quirk: hard-truncated around ~100-110 characters on longer titles, with no ellipsis -- the full headline is in the page's <title>/og:title tags but is not part of this JSON-LD block, so it is passed through as-is, not repaired.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode from JSON-LD). Often empty in latest-mode (RSS <description> is usually blank on this feed).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, from the upstream JSON-LD NewsArticle node (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article-mode: byline Person object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- list of dicts with name/url). Latest-mode: plain byline name string from the RSS feed's atom:author/atom:name.

authorUrl.title: Author URL
authorUrl.description: Author profile path from the RSS feed's atom:author/atom:uri (latest-mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Article-mode: list of plain image URL strings from JSON-LD (not ImageObject dicts). Latest-mode: single lead-image URL string from the RSS feed's media:content.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: Thumbnail image URL, smaller crop (latest-mode, from the RSS feed's media:thumbnail).

category.title: Category
category.description: Section/category name from the RSS <category> tag (latest-mode).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword/tag string. Populated in both article-mode (JSON-LD) and latest-mode (RSS media:keywords, though sometimes empty there).

url.title: URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted by JSON-LD (article-mode).

contentLocation.title: Content location
contentLocation.description: AdministrativeArea object(s) from JSON-LD (article-mode). Quirk: observed as a static 'Mumbai, India' value on every sampled article regardless of the story's actual dateline (e.g. a Bhopal-datelined story still carries this) -- appears to be a fixed publisher-HQ value, not a per-article geotag. Passed through as-is.

associatedMedia.title: Associated media
associatedMedia.description: Lead image object (JSON-LD @type is lower-cased 'imageObject' on this site, a minor upstream quirk) with url/caption/description/height/width (article-mode).

speakable.title: Speakable
speakable.description: SpeakableSpecification CSS selector hints for voice assistants (article-mode).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Paywall signal from JSON-LD. Observed as true on every sampled article -- no metering/paywall detected on Free Press Journal's main news content (article-mode).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item, full-length and NOT truncated the way article-mode headline is (latest-mode).

contentEncoded.title: Content (encoded)
contentEncoded.description:
Full article body as HTML markup (

tags), from the RSS feed's content:encoded element (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
